verdict.rationale: Google Cloud offers programmatic automation through the gcloud CLI, Cloud APIs and client libraries, plus declarative Terraform via Infrastructure Manager with preview deployments. Together these imply many resources can be changed in one apply or scripted loop. API hub's full metadata sync, which does bulk upserts and orphan deletes, is the only concrete many-item operation in the pack. missing for 10: explicit documentation of batch or bulk endpoints or commands (e.g., batch APIs, multi-resource gcloud operations), evidence of bulk actions across arbitrary item types, and independent hands-on corroboration.
